law: rule 82a: every tile, prop, car, street, sidewalk, kerb, marking, lamp and house skin comes FROM the approved packs, never cooked fresh

ground.words: terrain and desert: dirt, grass, water, rock, dead trees

lamp.words: lamps, fire barrels and what still burns

marking.words: what is painted or spilled ON the ground: warnings, hazards, blood

prop.words: props and the cars: crates, barrels, trash, tools, furniture, bones

road.words: streets, sidewalks, kerbs and the floors you walk on

settlement.words: houses and their skins: roofs, walls, windows, fences, stalls, ruins

how_to_use: Cite a twin as pack:<pack>#<idx>, which is the key he judged it under, and the vote gate checks it against his own 7/13 sweep. The PNG for that key is reference/art_bank/<family>/<file>. COOK TWO, COOK THREE and COOK FOUR build from these; nothing here is ours and nothing here may be redrawn.
